repositories.name: account-service
repositories.evidence: The API DTO accessors must change with the JSON rename; AddressController calls request.postalCode() at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/AddressController.java:65 and :81, and the response mapper constructs the renamed response field at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/infrastructure/mapping/AddressDtoMapper.java:14.

repositories.name: commerce-bff
repositories.evidence: Its address endpoints are an opaque relay: AddressProxyController accepts JsonNode and forwards it to account-service at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:41-43 and :65-69. Thus its public behavior changes, but it has no field-binding rename to make.

repositories.name: commerce-web
repositories.evidence: The frontend's Address type declares postalCode at commerce-web/src/api/types.ts:47-59; CheckoutPage both displays it and submits it at commerce-web/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx:112 and :119. It will otherwise send the obsolete request field and read an absent response field.

repositories.name: order-service
repositories.evidence: AccountClient deserializes Account's GET response into a local AddressResponse with postalCode at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/AccountClient.java:24-26 and copies it at :40-41. A provider response containing postcode leaves this consumer's postalCode unset unless this adapter is changed.

repositories.name: shipment-service
repositories.evidence: This is the downstream failure boundary, not a field-renaming target. If an order with a null snapshot reaches Kafka, the listener reads address.postalCode at shipment-service/src/main/java/com/poc/shipment/infrastructure/messaging/OrderConfirmedListener.java:32-40 and DeliveryEstimator rejects null/non-numeric values at shipment-service/src/main/java/com/poc/shipment/application/DeliveryEstimator.java:19-24.

repositories.name: commerce-platform
repositories.evidence: Its end-to-end clients post the old field through the BFF, for example commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/01-signup-to-confirmed-order/04-create-address.bru:17-25 and commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/run-e2e.sh:135-137.

symbols.evidence: postalCode is the validated JSON request component at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/dto/AddressRequest.java:7-15; rename it to postcode.
postalCode is the JSON response component at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/dto/AddressResponse.java:6-18; rename it to postcode.
The controller reads request.postalCode() when creating an address at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/AddressController.java:61-67.
The controller reads request.postalCode() when updating an address at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/AddressController.java:75-82.
It supplies address.postalCode() to the AddressResponse constructor at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/infrastructure/mapping/AddressDtoMapper.java:10-17.
The proxy receives an untyped JsonNode body and forwards it unchanged at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:40-44.
The update proxy likewise forwards the JsonNode unchanged at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:49-54.
The relay passes the supplied body directly to RestClient via body(body), without rebinding address fields, at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/infrastructure/client/DownstreamRelay.java:40-53.
Address declares postalCode and AddressInput derives from it at commerce-web/src/api/types.ts:47-61.
The checkout form initializes, renders, and updates postalCode at commerce-web/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx:12-21 and :112-121.
The client serializes AddressInput without translation at commerce-web/src/api/checkout.ts:8-12, so changing the type/UI changes the posted JSON field.
This by-name response binding still expects postalCode at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/AccountClient.java:24-26.

The Account response is converted into the local snapshot using response.postalCode() at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/AccountClient.java:30-43; adapt this boundary to response.postcode() while retaining the local snapshot name.
It sends address.postalCode() to shipment estimation at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/application/CheckoutService.java:41-59. With the stale Account binding this value is null.

The immediate normal-path failure is earlier than Kafka: Map.of rejects null while constructing the shipment REST body at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/ShipmentClient.java:30-47.

If a null snapshot is persisted or otherwise reaches saga emission, this method keeps the existing event key postalCode and writes the null value at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/application/SagaOrchestrator.java:104-113. Do not rename this event field merely because Account's REST field changed.
The Kafka consumer extracts the unchanged event field postalCode with asText(null) at shipment-service/src/main/java/com/poc/shipment/infrastructure/messaging/OrderConfirmedListener.java:27-45.
Null is converted to an empty string then rejected as an invalid PIN at shipment-service/src/main/java/com/poc/shipment/application/DeliveryEstimator.java:19-24.

contracts.evidence: The provider contract exposes postalCode in AddressRequest at account-service/openapi/account.yaml:190-224 and AddressResponse at account-service/openapi/account.yaml:225-252. POST, PUT, list, and get all reference those schemas at account-service/openapi/account.yaml:10-115.

The BFF publishes the address routes at commerce-bff/openapi/bff.yaml:11-94, but models their bodies as JsonNode; its relay code preserves callers' old postalCode JSON rather than translating it at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/infrastructure/client/DownstreamRelay.java:48-53.

This contract itself remains postalCode: ShipmentClient creates that request field at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/ShipmentClient.java:33-39 and ShipmentController binds it at shipment-service/src/main/java/com/poc/shipment/api/ShipmentController.java:39-43. It receives a null only if the AccountClient adapter is left stale.

The producer explicitly emits postalCode at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/application/SagaOrchestrator.java:104-113, and the published schema requires a string postalCode at order-service/asyncapi/schemas/order.confirmed.v1.json:10-20. Therefore this event contract is unchanged; a stale Account adapter can only produce a conditional invalid null payload, not a legitimate postcode event.

tests.evidence: Its create/update payloads and response assertions use postalCode at account-service/src/test/java/com/poc/account/AccountFlowComponentTest.java:111-143; it will fail validation and then assert the wrong response key.

The test compares the generated OpenAPI document with openapi/account.yaml at account-service/src/test/java/com/poc/account/OpenApiContractTest.java:48-65, so the committed schema must be regenerated after the DTO rename.
Its Address fixture declares postalCode at commerce-web/src/test/app.test.tsx:39-51; after the frontend type is migrated, this fixture must use postcode.
The Bruno request posts postalCode at commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/01-signup-to-confirmed-order/04-create-address.bru:17-25.
The Bruno request posts postalCode at commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/05-basket-changed-after-quote/04-create-address.bru:17-25.
The Bruno request posts postalCode at commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/06-out-of-stock/03-create-address.bru:17-25.
The Bruno request posts postalCode at commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/07-payment-decline/03-create-address.bru:17-25.
The Bruno request posts postalCode at commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/08-duplicate-place-order/03-create-address.bru:17-25.
Both scripted address payloads post postalCode at commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/run-e2e.sh:135-137 and :215-217.

Existing OrderApiMockedTest replaces AccountPort with a fake snapshot at order-service/src/test/java/com/poc/order/OrderApiMockedTest.java:75-76 and :342-347, so it cannot detect the renamed Account JSON field or the resulting null binding.
